tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Plan your limits are taken from.

guild_id.title: Guild Id
guild_id.description: Server the API key belongs to, and that these limits are counted for.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the limit, matching the `X-RateLimit-Bucket` header.

window_seconds.title: Window Seconds
window_seconds.description: Length of the window the limit is counted over.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Requests allowed in that window on your plan.

remaining.title: Remaining
remaining.description: Requests you have left in the current window.

reset_at.title: Reset At
reset_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds of when the window resets.

items.title: BucketState
items.description: How much of one limit is left.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Every limit that can apply to your requests.
